data.body: S2 6cd0 IMPLEMENTED + pushed as Gerrit change 2242 (stacked on 2237). Commit 6deacae372e0, 8 files, 301 insertions. Held-out TDD: 16-case oracle RED first, 3 happy-path visible, implementer passed visible tests on FIRST attempt, 16/16 on restore. One oracle defect was mine again (real TracerProvider needs the [tracing] SDK extra, absent here; rewrote as a get_current_span stub, which also added 2 branch cases I'd missed: INVALID zero trace id must not emit 32 zeroes, and non-recording span must mint). MUTATION: reverting runner.py:260 to None turned exactly test_structured_branch_carries_trace_id red while the findings-branch test stayed green — the two FakeRunner branches are independently covered. PRE-FLIGHT CAUGHT A BLOCKING CI FAILURE the tests could not see: runner.py went 797->807, over the hard 800 cap; corrective re-dispatch condensed comments back to exactly 800. EPIC RISK: config.py, gate_dispatch.py and runner.py are all at exactly 800 with zero headroom — the next ticket touching any of them needs an extraction first. file_impact updated to 8 paths (added run_identity.py and the generated docs/env-vars.md).
